chapter: Bags Jackson, Army tales and Gordon Parks films
title: Parks takes the main title credit
summary: Academy members offered a nomination if McIntosh was credited, but Gordon Parks refused, a betrayal that Parks's secretary also saw.

story.theme_name: Jazz musicians in the movies and film scoring
story.community_name: Jazz musicians on film and studio scoring

blocks.x: did the main title. If you give McIntosh credit, then we’ll nominate the show.” Gordon says, “No way.”

He had a wonderful English secretary. You know, Gordon always wants to deal with top flight, so he had Henry Brant. Why he settled for me, for his secretary he had a woman who had worked with Yerna and Low on My Fair Lady and all. So, she was really highly qualified. She watched the whole thing and more than that, she was like a mother. She says, “Here Mac, why don’t you have another cup of coffee and take your break now.” So, when she saw, having sat with me as I plowed this stuff out, she saw Gordon put his name. She had great respect for him and then she lost it after that. I couldn’t believe it. It’s one of the greatest irks I’ve ever had in my life.
